notes.title: New Black Cube game: Boinihi available now
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

A new episode in the Black Cube series (ASA, Catyph, Myha) is here!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1298050/Bonihi_The_Ki_Codex/


Scifi adventure game Boinihi is finally released after 4 years of hard work on my own at home! 
This game is reminiscent of the Myst series but also point and click games like Syberia, The Longest Journey...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1298050/extras/debut.gif?t=1590646663[/img]


[i]"An astronaut has been wandering through space for 4 years, and finally landed on an uncharted moon, where a mysterious hermit used to live alone. Boïnihi was his name, and he was one of the rare survivors of a terrible event known as "Day Zero", which happened long, long ago..." [/i]


Created with the help of Yazorius (music), Klemens Koehring (English voice), Rémy Létang (French voice), and all of my friends at the Icehouse collective.

[previewyoutube=_iDOSmYmzG8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


Available in English and French for Windows, $19.99 (save -10% if you choose the Black Cube bundle). 


https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/617/The_Black_Cube_series/


Don't miss the Bonus files in the game's folder (mp3, video, comic book...).

If you like to play the Black Cube games, don't forget to subscribe to my newsletter to be updated of the latest releases, and receive a few surprises on some occasions.
http://eepurl.com/dM3VFg

I really hope you like Boinihi! Thanks for your support during all these years! 

Simon

notes.title: Myha Community Playthrough (Let's Play Together)
notes.content: Hello! We have started a Community Playthrough (CPT) of Myha on the Steam Hub/Forums. If you never heard before about CPTs, it's a way to play together, which is perfect to help each other. If you are stuck in the world of Myha and want to ask us questions (wether regarding the game, or developer stories), it's a good opportunity to do it! We hope to see you there! The main developer Denis/Prom will be leading this CPT and will be happy to help you go through Myha and find all its secrets, trophies/successes/achievements, etc. It takes place here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/890280/discussions/0/1645418261863515968/

notes.title: Update 2.0.0
notes.content:
Hello ! 

Myha is now available in version 2.0.0. This new update adds 10 successes to unlock during the main adventure, as well as 20 bonus successes. 

We have also added a Japanese translation! 
Thanks to all our translators and Warlocs (http://warlocs.com/) ! 

Many bugs have also been fixed, making this the most successful version of the game. 

This will likely be one of the last major updates, and, unless there was a last-minute change, the version of the game that will be burned on the DVDs for our backers. 

Thank you all again for your feedback and support! 
See you soon!

notes.title: MYHA is released!
notes.content:
Thanks everyone for your patience and support! We have received a lot of kind words and positive feedback from our KS backers who discovered it in early access. They were either fans of Myst, adventure gamers, fans of The Black Cube series or other players from around the world. And they liked Myha, helped us to improve it, and now it's available in v1.1 "release"!
You can get it here on Steam or get it if you prefer on Game Jolt. 
Enjoy!
